AUTHOR: Muntaner-Gonzalez
TITLE: Automatic deep learning-based pipeline for Mediterranean fish segmentation
REGION: Mediterranean, coasts of Spain (IMEDEA Sub-Eye, OBSEA, MINKA); field tests on Spanish coast
SPECIES: 17 Mediterranean fish species (e.g., Diplodus vulgaris, D. sargus, Chromis chromis, Coris julis, Epinephelus marginatus)
DATA: New instance-segmentation dataset (4,635 images) from IMEDEA and OBSEA Roboflow datasets + MINKA citizen database; 98-image independent field test from own stereo vision system; DeepFish segmentation (310 images) for generic-fish model
V_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'a dataset with a variety of backgrounds, light conditions, and resolutions is generated.'; Sec. 6: 'changing lighting and water conditions'
D_EV: Sec. 3.1: 'The dataset is split into a trainval partition composed of 4,173 images (90% of the data) and a test partition composed of 462 images'
R_EV: Sec. 5.1: 'some of the images recorded during field tests have been manually labelled to serve as an independent test set.'; Table 8 vs Table 4 mAP50
C_EV: Sec. 5: 'If a fish is detected with a confidence level above a predefined threshold, the image is stored.' (threshold value never reported)
E_EV: Sec. 4: 'evaluated on the test partition, obtaining an mAP50(B) of 0.886 and an mAP50(M) of 0.890' (detection/segmentation metrics only)
ARCH: YOLOv8l-seg (benchmark), YOLOv8n-seg deployed on stereo vision system
METR: mAP50 (box and mask), F1, confusion matrix, inference time
NOTE: Split unit stated only as images (90/10, 'random' not stated); images pooled from multiple sources, no source/site-level separation -> D_ALL=N. External: 98-image field test from own SVS (different camera/deployment; nano model vs large model in-domain) and DeepFish (Australia, generic-fish model) with numeric results -> R_ALL=Y (note model-size confound for field test). Deployment uses an unspecified confidence threshold -> C1=NR, C_ALL=NR (authors state errors are missed/confused detections rather than FPs). Generic 'fish' class for species outside the 17 is a trained catch-all class, coded C4=N (verifier may consider it open-set handling). ENV not stated beyond 'Mediterranean' -> NR. Zenodo shares trained model and data; code not stated -> CODE=N. Day/night inference examples only in supplementary (qualitative).
